title: Zankaar 2.0
label: Geeta Rabari Official
description: A 29-track 2023 Geeta Rabari album from Geeta Rabari Official, running 63:02 across modern Gujarati Garba, traditional Garba, Mataji devotional and Krishna Garba. The official artist-channel full set is preserved alongside documented regional provider variance, while track 25 remains on release fallback because its published YouTube timestamp is malformed.
notes: Canonical track durations follow the 29-track UK/provider edition, whose track-2 duration is 3:16. Some Amazon regional storefronts expose a conflicting 7:04 value and longer album total. Track 25 remains on release fallback because the official YouTube description publishes its timestamp malformed; no timestamp was inferred.
